name: Smart and Skilled Fee-Free Scholarship
summary: Fee-free training up to Certificate IV for young NSW people aged 15 to 30 on a government payment, and other eligible groups.
key: If you're eligible, you can receive up to 2 fee-free scholarships over 4 years.
who: Aged 15 to 30 and receiving a government payment or benefit, and meet Smart and Skilled eligibility.
Also people who have experienced domestic or family violence, or who are or were in out-of-home care.
how: Eligibility is confirmed at enrolment; domestic violence and out-of-home care applicants provide supporting documents.
catches: Courses up to and including Certificate IV.
